label: GeoComputation and NZGRC meet in Queenstown
summary: GeoComputation returned to New Zealand on 18–21 September 2019, in conjunction with the New Zealand Geospatial Research Conference. Otago, Auckland, Canterbury and Victoria universities jointly organised the Queenstown event. The final institutional account lists Mark Gahegan among its keynote speakers.
